integrity: Universal proof by integral Lefschetz, Borel equivariant comparison and projective bundle formula. Finite enumerations are ancillary.
limitations: Applies to free invariant complete intersections of 2m+1 quadrics for m>=2, only degrees strictly less than 2m; primitive middle/higher cohomology and general Enriques manifolds are not classified. Historical priority is best knowledge and not independently certified.
title: Integral low-degree cohomology of the Enriques complete-intersection quadrics
